name: XlBordersIndex
description: Specifies the border to be retrieved.

constants.name: xlInsideHorizontal
constants.description: Horizontal borders for all cells in the range except borders on the outside of the range.

constants.name: xlInsideVertical
constants.description: Vertical borders for all the cells in the range except borders on the outside of the range.

constants.name: xlDiagonalDown
constants.description: Border running from the upper-left corner to the lower-right of each cell in the range.

constants.name: xlDiagonalUp
constants.description: Border running from the lower-left corner to the upper-right of each cell in the range.

constants.name: xlEdgeBottom
constants.description: Border at the bottom of the range.

constants.name: xlEdgeLeft
constants.description: Border at the left edge of the range.

constants.name: xlEdgeRight
constants.description: Border at the right edge of the range.

constants.name: xlEdgeTop
constants.description: Border at the top of the range.
